description: Department of Forest Conservation - Notify the Buruthagoda Reserved Forest
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of the Buruthagoda Forest as a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. The document contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, lot numbers, and specific land areas (totaling 392.3719 hectares) across multiple villages. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registration, boundary definitions, and land use designation for conservation purposes, rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
